From 486ede0df82dd74472c6f5651e38ff48f7f766c1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Brent Lu <brent.lu@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2023 15:41:58 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] ASoC: Intel: glk_rt5682_max98357a: fix board id mismatch

The drv_name in enumeration table for ALC5682I-VS codec does not match
the board id string in machine driver. Modify the entry of "10EC5682"
to enumerate "RTL5682" as well and remove invalid entry.

Fixes: 88b4d77d6035 ("ASoC: Intel: glk_rt5682_max98357a: support ALC5682I-VS codec")
Reported-by: Curtis Malainey <cujomalainey@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Curtis Malainey <cujomalainey@chromium.org>
Reviewed-by: Bard Liao <yung-chuan.liao@linux.intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Brent Lu <brent.lu@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Pierre-Louis Bossart <pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20231204214200.203100-4-pierre-louis.bossart@linux.intel.com
Signed-off-by: Mark Brown <broonie@kernel.org>

diff --git a/sound/soc/intel/common/soc-acpi-intel-glk-match.c b/sound/soc/intel/common/soc-acpi-intel-glk-match.c
index 387e73100884..8911c90bbaf6 100644
--- a/sound/soc/intel/common/soc-acpi-intel-glk-match.c
+++ b/sound/soc/intel/common/soc-acpi-intel-glk-match.c
@@ -19,6 +19,11 @@ static const struct snd_soc_acpi_codecs glk_codecs = {
 	.codecs = {"MX98357A"}
 };
 
+static const struct snd_soc_acpi_codecs glk_rt5682_rt5682s_hp = {
+	.num_codecs = 2,
+	.codecs = {"10EC5682", "RTL5682"},
+};

 struct snd_soc_acpi_mach snd_soc_acpi_intel_glk_machines[] = {
 	{

@@ -35,20 +40,13 @@ struct snd_soc_acpi_mach snd_soc_acpi_intel_glk_machines[] = {

 	},
 	{
-		.id = "10EC5682",
+		.comp_ids = &glk_rt5682_rt5682s_hp,
 		.drv_name = "glk_rt5682_mx98357a",

 		.machine_quirk = snd_soc_acpi_codec_list,

-	{

-	},

-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `soc-acpi-intel-glk-match.c`**
   - A new structure `glk_rt5682_rt5682s_hp` is added, which defines two codecs: "10EC5682" and "RTL5682".
   - The entry for the board ID "10EC5682" is modified to use the new `glk_rt5682_rt5682s_hp` structure for codec enumeration.
   - The previous entry for the board ID "RTL5682" is removed entirely, as it was deemed invalid.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modifications establish a relationship where the codec enumeration for the board ID "10EC5682" now includes both "10EC5682" and "RTL5682" under a single structure, thereby fixing the mismatch issue. The removal of the separate entry for "RTL5682" indicates that it is no longer treated as a distinct board ID but rather as an alternative representation of the same codec configuration associated with "10EC5682". This change aims to ensure consistency and correctness in the codec identification process within the driver.
